product_one_liner.value: Doxis is an AI-powered enterprise content-automation platform for organizations that classifies and extracts information from business documents and automates document-heavy workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Doxis as classifying, extracting, and centralizing enterprise documents and automating workflows with AI, supporting the one-sentence summary.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes licensing and deployment options, so a public pricing page exists even though prices are not listed.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Both names appear on SER Group's customer references page. | named_customers.0: Eissmann Group Automotive appears on the customer references page. | named_customers.1: adesso SE appears on the customer references page.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 353 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band. Confidence is medium because the count is a third-party profile figure.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company announcement names Bonn, Germany as the headquarters; the city is Bonn. | hq_country: The company announcement identifies Bonn, Germany as SER Group's headquarters; the country is Germany.

founded_year.notes: The company's announcement states it was founded in 1984. A structured company profile differs on the year, so the company's own statement is preferred and confidence is medium.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index and sampled entries show company/product-oriented and educational content, not at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built. Under the stated criteria, this is false; confidence is medium because this is based on the accessible index and reviewed entries.

public_docs.notes: Doxis provides public SDK documentation, implementation guides, and platform documentation, meeting the public documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page has a Full Stack AI Engineer posting, matching the specified AI/ML role criteria.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed AI FAQ and product documentation discuss AI/LLM capabilities but do not name a model or model provider. The provider is therefore unknown.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 19, 2026 announcement names new Chief AI Officer, Chief Revenue Officer, and VP of Sales EMEA appointments. These are C- or VP-level changes within the 12 months before the run date.
